patch_description: This approach replaces the previous structure with a highly expressive yet balanced "staircase" entangling strategy. The ansatz block begins with a dense layer of parameterized RX and RY rotations on all qubits to maximize feature representation capacity. This is followed by a "staircase" chain of CRZ gates (0-1, 1-2, ..., 7-0) which facilitates non-local correlation buildup across the qubit register. A subsequent layer of fixed CZ gates ensures sufficient mixing to prevent the state from becoming too sparse. This structure is designed to better capture the correlations between binary features in the 8-qubit space, leading to more robust generalization.
